leamington spa.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Royal Leamington Spa
s1loc: Royal Leamington Spa carries a busy live calendar for its size. The Royal Spa Centre runs the town's main auditorium and studio theatre for touring drama, music and comedy, while the Assembly on Spencer Street is the standing music room that has drawn national and international acts and once took Live Music Venue of the Year. Outdoors, Jephson Gardens and the Pump Room Gardens host open-air productions and the long-running Leamington Peace Festival, keeping staged events running across the warmer months.

Each autumn the Canterbury Festival spreads music, comedy and theatre across the city, staging concerts inside Canterbury Cathedral and in halls and rooms throughout the district.
